source.check: figures read from the page images of the Belfast Telegraph's ward results (BNA OCR unusable); names and full forms from the News-Letter's complete list of nominations; * = retiring member as printed; unopposed members are the only nominees for the seats in that list

note: Election of the whole of Belfast Corporation (an alderman and three councillors in each of the 15 wards) under the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946, polled Wednesday 18 September 1946; the first since the war. Seven wards were counted on the morning of 19 September and the rest that afternoon; the Unionists kept an overall majority of 26 (Belfast Telegraph, 19 and 20 September 1946). Falls, Smithfield and Windsor had no councillors' poll and Court, Smithfield and Windsor no aldermanic poll (Belfast News-Letter, 5 September 1946). Commonwealth Labour gain. The Telegraph does not mark Walsh as the retiring member; the News-Letter's list does.
